children: Shares of Texmaco Rail and Engineering Ltd. gained as much as 7% on Tuesday, September 1, after the company won an international order worth $135 million.
The company, in an exchange filing on Tuesday, said that Tsiko Africa Logistics with Barberry Holdings has issued the letter of award for the supply of Wabtec ES43ACi diesel-electric locomotives.
As per the scope of the order, Texmaco Rail will be responsible for the design, manufacture, supply and commission of Wabtec ES43ACi-4500 HP diesel-electric locomotives.
The order is to be executed within 20 to 24 months from the signature of the definitive agreement, the exchange filing stated.

Last week, Texmaco Rail inked a memorandum of understanding with Germany-based Bochumer Verein Verkehrstechnik GmbH (BVV) to explore a JV in India for railway wheelsets, wheels, axles and related components.
Texmaco Rail reported its first quarter earnings last month. The company's net profit increased 66.8% to ₹50 crore from ₹30 crore last year.
Its revenue of ₹757 crore was 16.9% lower than the previous fiscal's ₹911 crore.
The company's earnings before interest tax depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) declined 19.6% to ₹57 crore from ₹71 crore in the first quarter last year.
Its margins were flat at 8% compared to the year-ago period.

Shares of Texmaco Rail increased 7.3% to hit an intraday high of ₹116.9 apiece on Tuesday. The stock has cooled off from the initial spike, currently trading 3.3% higher at ₹112.5. The stock is still down 18% so far this year.

title: Texmaco Rail shares gain up to 7% after winning $135 million international order
